name: tablib-c8ff4e17-blind29
instr:
# Tablib gives wrong answers on almost every conversion path, diagnosed without a test suite

This library holds tabular data in memory and moves it to and from a long list of text and spreadsheet file kinds, and it now gives wrong answers on almost every path through it. The repository has received 29 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the data I feed it changed and nothing about my calling code changed, and most of what follows is silent wrong output rather than a crash, so please check each observation on its own.

Starting with plain in-memory work on one table: asking for its rows put in order by one of the columns hands them back in exactly the order I appended them, although the title attached to the result is still the one I gave. Pivoting a table so that its rows become its columns takes the pivoted result's new column titles and its new rows from one column further along than it should, never includes the source's leading column in the output, and no longer reproduces what I started from when I do it twice.

Handing the library a block of text and letting it guess what it is: a block whose values are separated by tabs is no longer recognised as such, while comma-separated text and the two common structured-text kinds are recognised as before. Comma-separated text whose lines end in a bare carriage return, the old Macintosh convention, no longer splits into rows at all, and writing that same data back out gives one long line instead of the two rows that went
